text: Yasmin's daughter Layla starts reception on 3rd September. Yasmin admitted she's dreading the drop-off more than Layla is.

Graham's son graduates from Leeds on 14 July at 2pm. He's driving up the night before with his wife, and they've booked a table somewhere nice afterwards. Graham says it took his son five years because of the gap year in Peru, so it's a big deal for the whole family. His daughter can't make it, she's working.
Pick up dry cleaning before Thursday. Shop closes at 5.30.
Abebe mentioned his brother Dev has his driving test on the 22nd at half 8. Third attempt, so he's pretty nervous. I should text Dev good luck that morning.
Lovely chat with Demi after yoga. Her twins finished their GCSEs last week and are already bored. She's vegetarian now, which I didn't know.
Fiona's mum is having her hip done on 9 November. Fiona's taking the week off to look after her. Remember to ring Fiona the evening after the op.
Anan said Santiago got into Edinburgh for medicine! Results came through this morning. Need to send him a card.

Boiler service booked for 28/10, between 8 and 12. Make sure someone's in. Also need to move the boxes out of the airing cupboard so the engineer can actually get to it, and find the warranty paperwork from last year, which I think is in the drawer under the printer.

Zhang's son Hoang is sitting his 11+ on Saturday morning. Zhang is more stressed about it than Hoang. Their dog Biscuit has also been ill all week, poor things. Zhang's wife has taken Hoang to a couple of practice papers at the library on Wednesday evenings, and they've promised him pizza and a film on Saturday night whatever happens. I should text Zhang on Saturday afternoon to see how it went.
Elena and her husband Nikolai are celebrating their 25th anniversary on 2nd December with a dinner at the Ivy. She hinted that he'd love a decent bottle of port.
Gemma rang. Her little one, Rosa, lost her first tooth today and they've had to invent a tooth fairy rate.
Blessing's graduation ceremony was cancelled because of the strike, so the university is doing a small one online instead on 18 December at 11am.
Shira is starting a PGCE in January. Teaching has always been the plan, she says. Lives in Bristol with her partner now.
Must renew my passport before the end of November. Photos first.
Nasser called about his dad. Hospital appointment Monday at 10, results of the scan. He sounded worn out. I'll check in with him on Monday afternoon.
Ciara's wedding is off. She and Darius split up last month and she's moved back in with her parents in Cork. Keep an eye on her.
Astrid's son Noah had his first day at secondary school yesterday. Apparently he came home and announced he'd joined the chess club and the choir.
Fang is allergic to nuts, properly allergic, carries an EpiPen. Worth remembering for the Christmas do.

Coffee with Imani. Her brother Andile has been made head of year at his school, starts after half term. She's very proud. Her mum's 70th is on the 30th of October and they're throwing a surprise lunch on the Sunday after, the 2nd, at 1pm. Imani asked if I could bring a dessert, which I said I would. Andile's wife is due in February too, so it's a big year for them.
Kasia Nowak says her daughter Ines has her grade 5 piano exam on 12 November, first thing. Ines is fine, it's Kasia who can't sleep.
Message from Tendai: his son's nursery nativity is 16th December at 2pm. He wants me to come. Need to ask for the afternoon off.
Dentist moved to Wednesday 5 November at quarter past 4.
Eduardo's mum passed away on Saturday. Funeral is likely the 3rd. Don't forget to send flowers to the house before then.
Aditi is moving to Manchester on 1st December for the new job. Her partner Zhang is staying here until the lease ends in March.
Graham was telling me about his granddaughter Demi, who just passed her driving test first time. He's already worried about insurance quotes.

Yasmin Ahmed is struggling at work since the restructure. Says her manager keeps moving deadlines. She's thinking about leaving in the new year. She's had an informal chat with a recruiter and has a first interview on 4th November at lunchtime, which she's keeping quiet. Her husband thinks she should go for it. Worth asking her how it went sometime that week.
Remind me to ask Abebe how his daughter's first week at uni went. She started at Sheffield on 27 September.
Note to self: car MOT due 19/11. Book it this week, ideally a Saturday morning slot.
Dev and his wife are off to Japan for three weeks from 4 April. First proper holiday since the kids.
Fiona's son Santiago is doing his A level mocks from 1st December. She says he's revising constantly and barely sleeping. I should send her that revision timetable app.
Anan's nephew is getting christened on the 9th of November at 11 in the morning. Anan is godfather and slightly terrified about the speech.
Rosa told me her son Eduardo, or Eddie as everyone calls him, finished his apprenticeship and got kept on full time. They're having a barbecue on Saturday at 4 to celebrate.
Elena says her dad is going into a care home next month. It's been a hard decision and she's exhausted. Call her this weekend.
Gemma's three-year-old starts nursery on Monday. Two mornings a week to begin with, 9 till 12.
Big shop on Saturday morning, then the tip. Need to get rid of the old desk.
Blessing Mensah mentioned her husband loves vintage cameras and has been eyeing a Leica for ages. Good to know for his 40th.
Shira's brother Nikolai is running the Manchester Marathon on 19 April. It's his first one and he's been training since June.
Nasser's daughter Aditi graduated with a first in law on Friday. He sent me the photo of her in the gown. Need to message Aditi congratulations.
Ciara and Noah are hosting a housewarming on 15 November from 7pm. Bring something fizzy.

Spoke to Astrid on the phone. Her mum fell on Tuesday and fractured her wrist. She's at home now but Astrid's going over every morning before work. Astrid sounded tired and a bit tearful. Ask how her mum's getting on next week, and maybe drop a lasagne round on Thursday evening.

Fang's cat Mochi went missing on Sunday night. They've put posters up all over the estate. Fang's daughter has been out every evening calling for her and is really upset. They've also registered her with the microchip company and posted on the local Facebook group. Keep an eye out on the walk to the station.
Imani prefers tea to coffee and hates anything with coconut in it.
Andile's interview for the deputy head role is on 6 November at 10am. He's quietly confident. Send him a message the night before.
Kasia's son finished his last exam today. Finally! He's going interrailing with his mates from 20 July for a month.
I'm taking Tendai's kids to the cinema on Saturday afternoon while he and his wife are at the hospital for the 20-week scan.
Return the library books by 24 October or I'll get fined again.
Hoang's girlfriend Ines got a place on the Royal Ballet summer school. Auditions were back in March and she'd given up hope. Lovely news.

Darius said his son failed his theory test last week and is rebooking for early December. He's taking it hard. Darius thinks it's nerves more than anything, because he knew the answers at home. His girlfriend has been testing him in the evenings. I should ask Darius how the rebooking went next time I see him at work.
Eduardo works nights at the hospital as a radiographer, so don't call before 2pm.
Aditi's sister Layla is expecting her first baby in May. Aditi is going to be an auntie and she's over the moon.
Follow up with Graham about his son's job interview. It was on Tuesday at 3pm and I forgot to ask when I saw him.

Yasmin's kids are both in the school play on the 11th, Thursday evening at 6.30. Her son has a speaking part and keeps forgetting his lines. Her daughter is a tree, which she's decided is the most important role in the whole production. Yasmin asked if I wanted a ticket, and I said yes, so I'm going with her mum. Need to buy the ticket before Friday.
Thought for the weekend: clear out the garage, then sort the loft on Sunday if there's time.
Abebe's wife Kim retires from the NHS on 31 March after 32 years. There's a do at the social club on 4th April at 7. I should chip in for the leaving present.
Demi's grandad is turning 90 on 21 January. The family are flying in from Canada for it. Demi said he'd love a framed photo of the old farm.
Santiago has a nasty back injury from rugby. Physio twice a week. He's gutted to miss the cup final on the 8th.
Zhang told me Elena's son started Year 1 this week and cried every morning, but by Friday he was running in without looking back.
Need to pay the council tax by the 1st. Direct debit failed again.

Long call with Gemma tonight. Her partner Andile has been offered a job in Dublin starting 12 January, and they're trying to decide whether to move the whole family. Their eldest, Rosa, is in Year 10 and doesn't want to change schools before her GCSEs, which is fair. Gemma is anxious about all of it. They've got a viewing on a house over there on 28 November, flying out Friday at 7am. Must check in with her after the viewing.
Had a quick catch-up. Nothing much new.
